crossRefs.note: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.
Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

translations.web: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.
translations.bsb: Asher will have one portion bordering the territory of Dan from east to west.
translations.kjv: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.
translations.asv: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, Asher, one portion.
